note: EEPROM 16 Kbit: <rom>.eep, 2048 bytes, console order. The game formats all 2 KiB at its first boot, and that is what this file holds: the script's Options -> MONO step did not land (three runs: the title and its attract story come at different times on the MiSTer, so the stick moves met the wrong screen; the proof shows the main menu after the reload, not Options). Against Mupen64Plus-Next's EEPROM region only 4 bytes differ, 0x000 and 0x400 (00 here, 0x40 there) and 0x3FB and 0x7FB (00 here, 01 there): the same two bytes in the game's two copies of its data, where Mupen's file records MONO. Main created the file FF-filled at ROM load (Auto Detect: eeprom2k); written on OSD open (Autosave On, the N64 default). The exact script is the MiSTer variant in scripts/mister/n64/ (START after 1500 frames).
